description: This file defines the Wallpaper activity for an Android application, allowing users to select and set wallpapers from a gallery of images.

classes.name: Wallpaper
classes.description: Main activity class for selecting and setting wallpapers.

classes.name: ImageAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying thumbnail images in the gallery.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the gallery and event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resets the wallpaper set flag when activity resumes.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Updates background when a gallery item is selected.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on gallery items to set wallpaper.

methods.name: selectWallpaper
methods.description: Sets the selected wallpaper, ensuring it's only set once.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Placeholder for no selection in gallery.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to set wallpaper.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns item at position (here, the position index).

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns item ID at position (here, the position index).

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates and returns ImageView for each thumbnail in the gallery.
